rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates confidence in ICM/TE quality from this static image and mislocalizes the ICM; zona thinning/expansion details are not carefully described relative to the image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, male-factor diagnosis, prior miscarriage, endometrium, lifestyle, and oocyte maturity data with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is structured, but there is an internal inconsistency: it estimates implantation at 45–60% yet states this is roughly a five-in-six chance of implantation, which is mathematically incorrect.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with IVF practice, including SET preference and caution about routine PGT-A/immune therapies; minor overreach includes suggesting APS workup after only one miscarriage.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management and future cycle review, especially around luteal support, SET, and trigger/oocyte maturity optimization, though some suggestions are broader than strictly indicated.
